intro: Hello! I’m Jonas Paul Yambao, a Senior Frontend/Mobile Developer with 7+ years of professional experience (since 2018) building and shipping web and mobile applications.
I specialize in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and frontend architecture, with strong exposure to CI/CD, cloud deployments, testing, and API integration.
I’ve worked across banking, analytics, logistics, and enterprise systems, leading frontend initiatives, mentoring developers, and partnering closely with product, design, and backend teams.
